from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Represents one judgment document with its assigned cause of action category."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The legal cause of action category assigned to this document from the predefined list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document] = Field(description="Collection of all judgment documents with their assigned cause of action categories")
